blocks.text: Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III on Saturday vowed to help address the development needs of Zamboanga Sibugay, pledging to personally raise the province’s healthcare and education priorities with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and work with local officials to improve transport connectivity. Speaking at the LegisHear town hall meeting at the Provincial Capitol Grounds in Ipil, Dy said he had taken note of the concerns raised by Gov. Dulce Ann Hofer and the province’s congressional representatives, particularly the need for better hospitals and educational facilities. “I will make sure na ang ating mga eskwelahan at ospital ay itutulak natin at […]...
